command: NXF_OFFLINE=true nextflow run pipeline -profile docker -c reference.config --input samplesheet.csv --scorefile PGS999997.txt --target_build GRCh38 --keep_multiallelic --min_overlap 0.95 --only_score --outdir results -ansi-log false

excluded_chromosomes.MT: The v2.3.0 pinned matcher filters targets to 1-22, X and Y. The same 52-row score file is supplied; 50 rows match.

configuration: Pinned release and default image tags; explicit sample sex on VCF import and --xchr-model 1 on scoring to match v3. Raw uncompressed .sscore requested. Resources capped for the small fixture; report/ancestry stages omitted with --only_score.
